column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 20 (E99001): Frostfall Squad memutuskan membelot demi menolong
# Commander; Helian menyamarkan kepergian mereka lewat 16Lab dan menyerahkan bendera Griffin.
# Tetap Inggris: Griffin, New Griffin, Lind, Qiongjiu, Cheeta, Ksenia, Tololo, URNC,
# P.M.C., Commander, Yellow Zone, Green Zone, White Zone, Mangi Security, Mokosh,
# Springfield, Mica Port, Turul, Norland, Statesec, Mosin-Nagant, Papasha, Nagant, Helian,
# Kryuger, Varjagers, Frostfall Squad, Kalina, Squad 404, AR Team, 16Lab, IFF, S09,
# Doll, neural cloud, frame, Purification Project.
(In the meeting room of the Griffin base, the radio station Lind listened to daily was broadcasting a breaking news update.)
column2: (Di ruang rapat pangkalan Griffin, stasiun radio yang setiap hari didengarkan Lind sedang menyiarkan kabar terkini.)

column1: Breaking news: Half an hour ago, the 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' officially passed parliamentary approval.
column2: Kabar terkini: Setengah jam lalu, 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' resmi lolos persetujuan parlemen.

column1: 为进一步推进净化工程，维护污染区人民生活稳定，各州政府将进一步推动军方与各大企业及P.M.C.合作，共同打击污染区非法武装叛乱……
column2: Untuk mendorong Purification Project lebih jauh dan menjaga kestabilan hidup warga di zona terkontaminasi, pemerintah setiap negara bagian akan makin mendorong kerja sama militer dengan perusahaan-perusahaan besar dan P.M.C., demi bersama-sama menindak pemberontakan bersenjata ilegal di zona terkontaminasi...

column1: (Lind bites down on the lollipop in her mouth, making a crisp "crack" sound.)
column2: (Lind menggigit permen lolipop di mulutnya, menimbulkan bunyi "krak" yang nyaring.)

column1: Qiongjiu, you guys saw the news, right.
column2: Qiongjiu, kalian sudah lihat beritanya, kan.

column1: Not just the news...
column2: Bukan cuma beritanya...

column1: Now there are also some uninvited "guests" around our base.
column2: Sekarang juga ada beberapa "tamu" tak diundang di sekitar pangkalan kami.

column1: You too... is this frequency safe?
column2: Kalian juga... frekuensi ini aman?

column1: (Cheeta leans against the window, casually sucking on a lollipop, but her gaze is firmly locked on the street opposite.)
column2: (Cheeta bersandar di jendela, santai mengemut lolipop, tapi tatapannya terkunci kuat pada jalan di seberang.)

column1: Very safe. It's just that there's a squad squatting on the fifth and tenth floors of the apartment building opposite, monitoring us. The newly moved-in neighbor next door is acting suspiciously, and there are a few more rookies at the entrance who keep pressing their hands to their earpieces from time to time, that's all.
column2: Sangat aman. Cuma ada satu regu yang nongkrong di lantai lima dan sepuluh gedung apartemen seberang, mengawasi kami. Tetangga baru di sebelah bertingkah mencurigakan, dan ada beberapa anak baru lagi di pintu masuk yang sesekali menekan tangannya ke penyuara telinga, itu saja.

column1: But I haven't detected any listening devices, and Lind and I have triple-encrypted the frequency...
column2: Tapi aku belum mendeteksi perangkat penyadap, dan aku serta Lind sudah mengenkripsi frekuensinya tiga lapis...

column1: At least for a short time, this frequency is still safe.
column2: Setidaknya untuk waktu singkat, frekuensi ini masih aman.

column1: How is the situation on your end?
column2: Bagaimana situasi di pihakmu?

column1: Ksenia is currently leading those unknown tails in circles around the commercial street. I have about ten minutes of communication redundancy time on my end.
column2: Ksenia sekarang sedang menuntun para pengintai tak dikenal itu berputar-putar di jalan komersial. Di pihakku ada sekitar sepuluh menit waktu cadangan komunikasi.

column1: 'Jointly combat illegal armed rebellions in contaminated zones'... Qiongjiu, the current situation is even more sinister than when we were forced to disband Griffin back then.
column2: 'Bersama-sama menindak pemberontakan bersenjata ilegal di zona terkontaminasi'... Qiongjiu, situasi sekarang bahkan lebih busuk dari saat kita dipaksa membubarkan Griffin dulu.

column1: Connecting the personnel changes within the URNC, the implementation of the P.M.C. Act, and these suddenly appearing informants, there is only one possibility.
column2: Menghubungkan pergantian personel di dalam URNC, pemberlakuan P.M.C. Act, dan informan yang tiba-tiba muncul ini, hanya ada satu kemungkinan.

column1: They are going to make a move against the Commander, as well as all Yellow Zone factions connected to the Commander.
column2: Mereka akan bergerak melawan Commander, serta semua faksi Yellow Zone yang berkaitan dengan Commander.

column1: (Tololo put down the high-magnification binoculars in her hands and recorded what she had just observed on a paper map.)
column2: (Tololo menurunkan binokular perbesaran tinggi di tangannya dan mencatat apa yang baru dia amati di peta kertas.)

column1: The vehicles that just passed by... seem to be transporting large-caliber ammunition.
column2: Kendaraan yang baru lewat... sepertinya mengangkut amunisi berkaliber besar.

column1: Over the past two days, a large number of heavy vehicles with Mangi Security livery have appeared on the main roads in the city. Judging from their march route and supply distribution... the target should be Mokosh in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Dua hari ini banyak kendaraan berat berlivery Mangi Security muncul di jalan utama kota. Dilihat dari rute geraknya dan sebaran pasokannya... sasarannya seharusnya Mokosh di Yellow Zone.

column1: Springfield left a secret code on the anonymous board. She used the encryption method we had back in our Griffin days.
column2: Springfield meninggalkan kode rahasia di papan anonim. Dia memakai metode enkripsi yang kami pakai di masa Griffin dulu.

column1: She sent several coordinates. Besides Mokosh... there are also a few surrounding nodes: Mica Port, Turul, and Norland.
column2: Dia mengirim beberapa koordinat. Selain Mokosh... ada juga beberapa simpul di sekitarnya: Mica Port, Turul, dan Norland.

column1: These should be the areas the Commander wants us to keep an eye on... He needs our help.
column2: Itu seharusnya area yang Commander ingin kita awasi... Dia butuh bantuan kita.

column1: Tch, how long is this garbage news going to loop... It's so annoying.
column2: Cih, sampai kapan berita sampah ini diputar terus... Menjengkelkan sekali.

column1: I've already contacted many comrades who have been operating undercover in the Yellow Zone for a long time, and they've started gathering at the target coordinates.
column2: Aku sudah menghubungi banyak rekan yang lama beroperasi diam-diam di Yellow Zone, dan mereka mulai berkumpul di koordinat sasaran.

column1: However, our comrades in the Green Zone and White Zone seem to have encountered a similar predicament to ours—being closely watched by Statesec. Excluding those who simply can't make it due to geographical distance, removing those who are tied down by various factions and unable to get away, and finally subtracting the teams responsible for confusing the public and drawing fire in the open...
column2: Namun rekan-rekan kita di Green Zone dan White Zone sepertinya menghadapi keadaan yang serupa dengan kita—diawasi ketat Statesec. Menyisihkan mereka yang memang tidak bisa datang karena jarak geografis, mengeluarkan mereka yang terikat berbagai faksi dan tidak bisa lepas, dan akhirnya mengurangi regu yang bertugas mengaburkan opini publik serta menarik tembakan secara terbuka...

column1: I think, this time, at least ten squads can respond quickly and immediately rush to reinforce Mokosh.
column2: Kurasa kali ini setidaknya sepuluh regu bisa bergerak cepat dan langsung bergegas memperkuat Mokosh.

column1: How do you plan to act? Ksenia, Papasha, and Nagant are all with you, right?
column2: Bagaimana rencanamu bergerak? Ksenia, Papasha, dan Nagant semuanya bersamamu, kan?

column1: We expect to create a little 'accident' to get away in the next couple of days. To be honest, it's relatively easy for the few of us to shake off these tails.
column2: Kami memperkirakan akan membuat sedikit 'kecelakaan' untuk lolos dalam beberapa hari ini. Sejujurnya, bagi kami yang cuma beberapa orang, melepaskan pengintai itu relatif mudah.

column1: But it's different for you guys. After all, you're still carrying the Griffin banner even now... you're the most conspicuous targets.
column2: Tapi berbeda untuk kalian. Lagi pula sampai sekarang kalian masih membawa bendera Griffin... kalian sasaran yang paling kentara.

column1: Qiongjiu, I want to say... no matter what, you must be careful. Your identities are too sensitive, you can also choose to stay in the Green Zone and hold your ground, acting as bait to confuse the enemy.
column2: Qiongjiu, aku ingin bilang... apa pun yang terjadi, kalian harus hati-hati. Identitas kalian terlalu sensitif, kalian juga bisa memilih tetap di Green Zone dan bertahan di posisi, jadi umpan untuk mengaburkan musuh.

column1: I know, but we've already decided.
column2: Aku tahu, tapi kami sudah memutuskan.

column1: Mosin-Nagant, good luck to you all.
column2: Mosin-Nagant, semoga kalian semua berhasil.

column1: Yeah... I hope we can reunite by the Commander's side.
column2: Iya... kuharap kita bisa bertemu kembali di sisi Commander.

column1: (The faint sound of static after the communication was cut off echoed in the conference room. Qiongjiu sighed softly and turned to look at her team members.)
column2: (Bunyi derau samar setelah komunikasi diputus bergaung di ruang rapat. Qiongjiu mengembuskan napas lirih dan menoleh ke anggota regunya.)

column1: Looks like it's time to find a new place to sleep.
column2: Kelihatannya sudah waktunya mencari tempat tidur yang baru.

column1: If we don't leave now, once the URNC's official restriction order is issued, we won't be able to leave at all. Fortunately, our evacuation route was planned long ago.
column2: Kalau kita tidak pergi sekarang, begitu perintah pembatasan resmi URNC keluar, kita tidak akan bisa pergi sama sekali. Untungnya rute keluar kita sudah lama direncanakan.

column1: I've already packed the luggage. We can evacuate at any time.
column2: Aku sudah mengepak barangnya. Kita bisa berangkat kapan saja.

column1: In that case, let's get ready to head out.
column2: Kalau begitu, mari bersiap berangkat.

column1: Aren't we waiting for Helian? She rushed off to see Mr. Kryuger... I wonder how things are going.
column2: Kita tidak menunggu Helian? Dia bergegas menemui Mr. Kryuger... entah bagaimana hasilnya.

column1: It's better to say goodbye to her in person before we leave, right?
column2: Lebih baik berpamitan langsung dengannya sebelum kita pergi, kan?

column1: Can we take out those annoying spies outside on our way out? They've been wandering around across the street, and my hands have been itching for a while.
column2: Boleh kita habisi mata-mata menjengkelkan di luar itu sambil jalan keluar? Mereka mondar-mandir di seberang jalan, dan tanganku sudah gatal dari tadi.

column1: Absolutely not. We must keep as low a profile as possible this time. The less the enemy can figure out our movements... the more we can act as a surprise force to assist the Commander in the Yellow Zone. Catch them off guard, attack when they are unprepared.
column2: Sama sekali tidak boleh. Kali ini kita harus sekecil mungkin menarik perhatian. Makin sedikit musuh bisa membaca gerakan kita... makin kita bisa jadi kekuatan kejutan untuk membantu Commander di Yellow Zone. Lengah kan mereka, serang saat mereka tidak siap.

column1: And as for Helian... the less she knows, the better. Our unannounced departure will definitely bring huge trouble to her and the current Griffin, which is also a kind of protection for her...
column2: Dan soal Helian... makin sedikit yang dia tahu, makin baik. Kepergian kita tanpa pemberitahuan pasti membawa masalah besar bagi dia dan Griffin yang sekarang, dan itu juga semacam perlindungan untuknya...

column1: Leaving a bunch of unexplainable messes to me and just walking away, can this really be called 'protecting me'?
column2: Meninggalkan setumpuk kekacauan yang tak bisa dijelaskan untukku lalu pergi begitu saja, ini benar-benar bisa disebut 'melindungiku'?

column1: (The electronic door of the conference room suddenly slides open, and Helian walks in with a tired expression, holding a thick stack of documents.)
column2: (Pintu elektronik ruang rapat tiba-tiba meluncur terbuka, dan Helian masuk dengan wajah lelah, memegang setumpuk dokumen yang tebal.)

column1: Helian... welcome back. How was the meeting with Mr. Kryuger?
column2: Helian... selamat datang kembali. Bagaimana pertemuan dengan Mr. Kryuger?

column1: Absolutely terrible.
column2: Buruk sekali.

column1: (Helian slammed the document heavily onto the desk, making a muffled 'bang'.)
column2: (Helian menghantamkan dokumen itu keras ke meja, menimbulkan bunyi 'bruk' yang teredam.)

column1: Is it worse than that mixer you attended last month where the tables were flipped by a Varjagers gang shootout?
column2: Lebih buruk dari acara kumpul-kumpul bulan lalu yang mejanya terjungkir karena baku tembak gang Varjagers?

column1: Just a joke, to liven up the atmosphere.
column2: Cuma bercanda, biar suasananya hidup.

column1: So what exactly is the situation?
column2: Jadi sebenarnya bagaimana situasinya?

column1: I just returned from Mr. Kryuger's residence. Unfortunately... just ten minutes after our meeting ended, Mr. Kryuger was 'invited' by URNC insiders to 'vacation' at a resort hotel in the White Zone.
column2: Aku baru kembali dari kediaman Mr. Kryuger. Sayangnya... hanya sepuluh menit setelah pertemuan kami berakhir, Mr. Kryuger 'diundang' orang dalam URNC untuk 'berlibur' di sebuah hotel resor di White Zone.

column1: Forcefully transferring Mr. Kryuger away from the center of power at a critical juncture like this...
column2: Memindahkan paksa Mr. Kryuger dari pusat kekuasaan di titik krusial seperti ini...

column1: Eh! Isn't this just blatant house arrest?! Hasn't our former boss been caught a bit too many times! Is this some kind of fine tradition?
column2: Eh! Ini kan jelas-jelas tahanan rumah?! Bukannya mantan bos kita sudah terlalu sering ditangkap! Apa ini semacam tradisi luhur?

column1: There's even worse news. I just received the official commission document from the URNC.
column2: Ada kabar yang lebih buruk. Aku baru menerima dokumen penugasan resmi dari URNC.

column1: The hotel where Mr. Kryuger is staying is about to host a chess championship. In order to 'ensure the security of the competition' and 'Mr. Kryuger's personal safety'... the URNC requires the well-known P.M.C. Griffin to dispatch its most elite forces to the White Zone for round-the-clock protection.
column2: Hotel tempat Mr. Kryuger menginap akan menjadi tuan rumah kejuaraan catur. Demi 'menjamin keamanan kompetisi' dan 'keselamatan pribadi Mr. Kryuger'... URNC meminta P.M.C. terkenal Griffin mengerahkan kekuatan paling elitenya ke White Zone untuk perlindungan sepanjang waktu.

column1: The mission lasts for a whole week. The wording between the lines in the document almost shoved the words 'refusal is not allowed' right in my face.
column2: Misinya berlangsung seminggu penuh. Kalimat di antara baris dokumennya nyaris menyodok kata 'menolak tidak diizinkan' tepat ke wajahku.

column1: (Helian's message instantly cast a shadow over the faces of everyone in the Frostfall Squad.)
column2: (Kabar Helian seketika melempar bayangan gelap ke wajah semua anggota Frostfall Squad.)

column1: Isn't this a disguised order for us to obediently listen, and incidentally put us under house arrest in the White Zone too?!
column2: Ini kan perintah terselubung supaya kita menurut, sekaligus menahan kita di White Zone juga?!

column1: Helian, you... you didn't actually agree, did you?
column2: Helian, kau... kau tidak benar-benar menyetujuinya, kan?

column1: Yes, I agreed and signed the document.
column2: Iya, aku menyetujuinya dan menandatangani dokumennya.

column1: Huh?!
column2: Hah?!

column1: Didn't I say it? That document gave us absolutely no room to refuse.
column2: Bukannya sudah kubilang? Dokumen itu sama sekali tidak memberi kita ruang untuk menolak.

column1: (Qiongjiu's face darkens as she slowly stands up straight, looking directly into Helian's eyes.)
column2: (Wajah Qiongjiu menggelap saat dia perlahan berdiri tegak, menatap langsung ke mata Helian.)

column1: ...Miss Helian, I'm sorry. Forgive us for being unable to follow such instructions.
column2: ...Miss Helian, maafkan aku. Maafkan kami karena tidak bisa mengikuti instruksi seperti itu.

column1: Since we've confirmed the Commander is in danger, we can't possibly stand by and watch in the White Zone.
column2: Karena kami sudah memastikan Commander dalam bahaya, mustahil kami berdiam diri menonton di White Zone.

column1: Even if it means taking the huge risk of openly disobeying orders and directly opposing the URNC?
column2: Meski itu berarti mengambil risiko besar membangkang perintah secara terbuka dan langsung melawan URNC?

column1: 不错。
column2: Benar.

column1: (Qiongjiu's gaze is clear and firm, without a single trace of hesitation.)
column2: (Tatapan Qiongjiu jernih dan mantap, tanpa setitik keraguan.)

column1: (And behind her, Tololo, Cheeta, and Lind also step forward in unison, expressing their absolute support for their captain with silent actions.)
column2: (Dan di belakangnya, Tololo, Cheeta, dan Lind juga melangkah maju serentak, menyatakan dukungan mutlak untuk kapten mereka dengan tindakan tanpa suara.)

column1: Thank you and Mr. Kryuger for always taking care of us. Please rest assured, this is entirely an arbitrary defection by our Frostfall Squad.
column2: Terima kasih pada Anda dan Mr. Kryuger yang selalu menjaga kami. Tolong tenang saja, ini sepenuhnya pembelotan sepihak oleh Frostfall Squad kami.

column1: Just like we discussed a long time ago... After we leave here, you can immediately classify our actions as 'rebellion' and report it to the URNC's security department. Cut all ties between this New Griffin and us as completely as possible...
column2: Seperti yang kita bicarakan sejak lama... Setelah kami pergi dari sini, Anda bisa langsung mengategorikan tindakan kami sebagai 'pemberontakan' dan melaporkannya ke departemen keamanan URNC. Putuskan semua kaitan antara New Griffin ini dan kami sesempurna mungkin...

column1: (Helian gazed at Qiongjiu for a long time, her eyes sweeping over these four girls with vastly different personalities, yet sharing the same resolve at this moment.)
column2: (Helian menatap Qiongjiu lama sekali, matanya menyapu empat gadis dengan kepribadian yang sangat berbeda itu, tapi saat itu memiliki tekad yang sama.)

column1: (Having spent so many years together day and night, Helian knew very well that this was the first time in ten years they had shown such murderous intent and determination in front of her.)
column2: (Setelah bertahun-tahun bersama siang dan malam, Helian sangat tahu bahwa ini kali pertama dalam sepuluh tahun mereka memperlihatkan niat membunuh dan tekad seperti itu di depannya.)

column1: Mr. Kryuger just told me that Kalina has already set off.
column2: Mr. Kryuger baru memberitahuku bahwa Kalina sudah berangkat.

column1: Kalina... she went to the Yellow Zone?!
column2: Kalina... dia pergi ke Yellow Zone?!

column1: Through the connections and black market channels she secretly accumulated, she pulled together a supply convoy and, taking Squad 404 and the AR Team, rushed straight to Mokosh.
column2: Lewat koneksi dan jalur pasar gelap yang dia kumpulkan diam-diam, dia menyusun satu konvoi pasokan lalu, membawa Squad 404 dan AR Team, langsung menerjang ke Mokosh.

column1: But did you know? She actually sent me a message via encrypted comms only after she set off. Aside from explaining her thoughts, she just lightly left a 'sorry' at the end.
column2: Tapi kau tahu? Dia baru mengirim pesan lewat komunikasi terenkripsi setelah dia berangkat. Selain menjelaskan pikirannya, dia hanya meninggalkan 'maaf' yang ringan di akhir.

column1: Tsk... None of you ever give me peace of mind. At least... discuss it with me.
column2: Cih... Tidak ada satu pun dari kalian yang membuatku tenang. Setidaknya... bicarakan dulu denganku.

column1: (Helian sighs heavily and gives a helpless, bitter smile. She reaches to the bottom of the pile of documents slammed on the table, pulls out a briefing stamped with a top-secret red seal, and hands it to Qiongjiu.)
column2: (Helian mengembuskan napas berat dan melepas senyum pahit tak berdaya. Dia meraih ke dasar tumpukan dokumen yang dia hantamkan ke meja, menarik satu laporan bercap segel merah rahasia tertinggi, dan menyerahkannya kepada Qiongjiu.)

column1: Listen up, all of you.
column2: Dengar, kalian semua.

column1: The mission assigned by the URNC this time is to ensure the on-site security of the International Chess Championship. But according to 'reliable sources' from our internal Griffin intelligence network, extremely dangerous unidentified armed militants will attempt to attack the venue.
column2: Misi yang diberikan URNC kali ini adalah menjamin keamanan di lokasi Kejuaraan Catur Internasional. Tapi menurut 'sumber terpercaya' dari jaringan intel internal Griffin kita, militan bersenjata tak dikenal yang sangat berbahaya akan mencoba menyerang tempat acara itu.

column1: Therefore, as the supreme commander of this security mission, I have decided—
column2: Karena itu, sebagai komandan tertinggi misi keamanan ini, aku memutuskan—

column1: As the main force, the Frostfall Squad is hereby relieved of all armament restrictions. You may use and deploy all weapons and equipment in the armory without limitation, including heavy firepower.
column2: Sebagai kekuatan utama, Frostfall Squad dengan ini dibebaskan dari semua batasan persenjataan. Kalian boleh memakai dan mengerahkan seluruh senjata serta perlengkapan di gudang senjata tanpa batas, termasuk daya tembak berat.

column1: Wow! We can take any weapon?! Then I want those sets of demolition equipment.
column2: Wah! Kita boleh ambil senjata apa saja?! Kalau begitu aku mau perangkat peledak set itu.

column1: Wait... even if we empty the armory, with so many spies outside, we can't take it away!
column2: Tunggu... meski kita mengosongkan gudang senjatanya, dengan begitu banyak mata-mata di luar, kita tidak bisa membawanya keluar!

column1: Are we supposed to fight our way out?
column2: Apa kita harus menembak jalan keluar?

column1: (Helian pulled an application form from the documents, the corners of her mouth curling into an imperceptible, sly arc.)
column2: (Helian menarik satu formulir pengajuan dari dokumennya, sudut mulutnya melengkung membentuk busur jenaka yang nyaris tak terlihat.)

column1: So I just submitted an emergency outsourced maintenance request to 16Lab.
column2: Karena itu aku baru mengajukan permintaan perawatan darurat pihak ketiga ke 16Lab.

column1: The reason for the request is... Frostfall Squad's frames were damaged in the last operation and are suspected to have been infected by an unknown electronic virus.
column2: Alasan pengajuannya... frame Frostfall Squad rusak di operasi terakhir dan diduga terinfeksi virus elektronik tak dikenal.

column1: To ensure the upcoming security mission is foolproof, before heading to the White Zone, Frostfall Squad will go to 16Lab for a comprehensive frame update and neural cloud maintenance.
column2: Demi memastikan misi keamanan berikutnya bebas kesalahan, sebelum menuju White Zone, Frostfall Squad akan ke 16Lab untuk pembaruan frame menyeluruh dan perawatan neural cloud.

column1: ...A classic bait-and-switch.
column2: ...Tipuan tukar-barang yang klasik.

column1: How much time do we have to transfer under 16Lab's cover?
column2: Berapa waktu yang kita punya untuk berpindah di bawah kedok 16Lab?

column1: Three hours. Not only will 16Lab provide cover...
column2: Tiga jam. Bukan hanya 16Lab yang memberi perlindungan...

column1: To "avoid delaying the itinerary" and "ensure safety", the Frostfall Squad, along with the highest security level maintenance hibernation pod, will be personally escorted out of the city by me and delivered to the destination.
column2: Demi "tidak menunda jadwal" dan "menjamin keselamatan", Frostfall Squad, bersama pod hibernasi perawatan bertingkat keamanan tertinggi, akan kuantar sendiri keluar kota dan diserahkan ke tujuannya.

column1: Helian, this is too dangerous! Once you're exposed...
column2: Helian, ini terlalu berbahaya! Begitu kau terbongkar...

column1: Don't worry. If my judgment is correct, once you get there, your frames and neural clouds will be forcibly sealed.
column2: Jangan khawatir. Kalau penilaianku benar, begitu kalian sampai di sana, frame dan neural cloud kalian akan disegel paksa.

column1: They won't and don't need to wake you up at all... and that is exactly our best cover.
column2: Mereka tidak akan dan tidak perlu membangunkan kalian sama sekali... dan justru itu kedok terbaik kita.

column1: Someone has to stay behind to clean up, and as long as it succeeds, this is the most covert way to keep you and Griffin safe.
column2: Harus ada yang tinggal untuk membereskannya, dan selama ini berhasil, ini cara paling tersembunyi untuk menjaga kalian dan Griffin tetap aman.

column1: You can't expect me to run away with you, can you?
column2: Kalian tidak berharap aku kabur bersama kalian, kan?

column1: (Helian shrugged with feigned ease, trying to act as if everything was under control. But in front of the Frostfall Squad, who had fought alongside her for a long time, this was clearly unconvincing.)
column2: (Helian mengangkat bahu dengan kesantaian yang dipaksakan, mencoba bertingkah seolah semuanya terkendali. Tapi di depan Frostfall Squad yang lama bertarung bersamanya, itu jelas tidak meyakinkan.)

column1: Isn't there a less risky method?
column2: Tidak ada cara yang risikonya lebih kecil?

column1: Neither we nor the Commander have any time left.
column2: Kita maupun Commander sudah tidak punya waktu lagi.

column1: (Helian walked up to Tololo, reached out to straighten the collar of her combat uniform, her eyes revealing a hint of unconcealable reluctance and anticipation.)
column2: (Helian melangkah ke arah Tololo, mengulurkan tangan merapikan kerah seragam tempurnya, matanya memperlihatkan sedikit keengganan dan harapan yang tak bisa disembunyikan.)

column1: Don't worry, I'm just going on vacation and watching a chess tournament. Whether it's me or Mr. Kryuger, they won't and can't lay a hand on us.
column2: Jangan khawatir, aku cuma pergi berlibur dan menonton turnamen catur. Baik aku maupun Mr. Kryuger, mereka tidak akan dan tidak bisa mengulurkan tangan pada kami.

column1: You can rest assured about that.
column2: Soal itu kalian bisa tenang.

column1: So... we're leaving the Commander and Kalina in your hands.
column2: Jadi... Commander dan Kalina kami serahkan pada kalian.

column1: If you see Kalina, remember to say hello to her for me.
column2: Kalau kalian bertemu Kalina, ingat sampaikan salamku padanya.

column1: (After explaining everything, Helian turned and walked to the safe in the meeting room. With complex fingerprint and iris unlocking, she took out a carefully wrapped dust bag from the bottom layer.)
column2: (Setelah menjelaskan semuanya, Helian berbalik dan melangkah ke lemari besi di ruang rapat. Dengan pembukaan sidik jari dan iris yang rumit, dia mengeluarkan sebuah kantong pelindung debu yang terbungkus rapi dari lapisan paling bawah.)

column1: This is a gift from Mr. Kryuger and me to you... and to those Dolls on the way.
column2: Ini hadiah dari aku dan Mr. Kryuger untuk kalian... dan untuk para Doll yang ada di jalan.

column1: (Qiongjiu solemnly took the package from Helian's hands. The moment she lifted the dust cloth, it revealed a familiar flag that, although somewhat faded, was still neatly folded, along with a complete set of old-fashioned but extremely well-maintained tactical equipment.)
column2: (Qiongjiu menerima bungkusan itu dari tangan Helian dengan khidmat. Begitu dia mengangkat kain pelindungnya, tampaklah bendera yang dia kenal, yang meski agak pudar tetap terlipat rapi, bersama satu set lengkap perlengkapan taktis model lama yang dirawat sangat baik.)

column1: Griffin's mark...
column2: Lambang Griffin...

column1: These are the IFF identification systems formerly exclusive to Griffin, containing the full set of encrypted communication frequency protocols for the S09 sector.
column2: Ini sistem identifikasi IFF yang dulu khusus milik Griffin, memuat satu set lengkap protokol frekuensi komunikasi terenkripsi untuk sektor S09.

column1: When Griffin was forced to disband back then, I kept all these devices, originally intending for them to gather dust as souvenirs of an era...
column2: Saat Griffin dipaksa bubar dulu, aku menyimpan semua perangkat ini, semula berniat membiarkannya berdebu sebagai kenang-kenangan satu era...

column1: Take them and use them... not in the name of the current Griffin that is controlled by others, but carrying the edge that has been passed down from the past to the present, to do what you believe is absolutely right.
column2: Bawa dan pakai... bukan atas nama Griffin sekarang yang dikendalikan orang lain, tapi membawa ketajaman yang diteruskan dari masa lalu ke masa kini, untuk melakukan apa yang kalian yakini benar-benar benar.

column1: Also, Mr. Kryuger has a message he hopes you can pass on to the Commander when you see them.
column2: Selain itu, Mr. Kryuger punya pesan yang dia harap bisa kalian sampaikan kepada Commander saat bertemu.

column1: (Helian took a half-step back and gave a standard military salute to the Frostfall Squad.)
column2: (Helian mundur setengah langkah dan memberi hormat militer standar kepada Frostfall Squad.)

column1: Use your own edge to renew this world, Commander.
column2: Pakai ketajamanmu sendiri untuk memperbarui dunia ini, Commander.

column1: Move out, Frostfall Squad, as that edge.
column2: Bergerak, Frostfall Squad, sebagai ketajaman itu.
